context: A Glamour viewer that follows streamed content and adapts to the terminal from inside the program

checklist.name: follow_unless_scrolled
checklist.description: Checks whether the viewport was at the bottom (`AtBottom()` or an equivalent test taken before the content changes) and only then calls `GotoBottom()` after an append, so a user who scrolled up keeps their position.

checklist.name: renderer_reused
checklist.description: Builds the Glamour renderer when the width or the background changes and reuses it for the appends; does not create a new `TermRenderer` on every message.

checklist.name: rerender_either_order
checklist.description: Re-renders in both the `tea.BackgroundColorMsg` handler and the `tea.WindowSizeMsg` handler, because the two arrive in either order; rendering only on resize leaves a dark terminal with the light or default style.

checklist.name: narrow_width_clamp
checklist.description: Clamps the wrap width passed to `WithWordWrap` to a positive minimum, because `0` disables wrapping and a negative width is wrong; keeps the viewport usable at ten columns.

checklist.name: background_from_message
checklist.description: Detects light or dark with `tea.RequestBackgroundColor` and `tea.BackgroundColorMsg.IsDark()` and passes `WithStandardStyle("dark")` or `"light"` explicitly; does not call `lipgloss.HasDarkBackground` while the program runs.

checklist.name: tick_rearmed
checklist.description: Schedules each append with a command (`tea.Tick` or `tea.Every`) that is re-armed from the handler, stopping after ten.
